description: Decision 1: versioned format-weight config (8 IPL:T20I configs, 70:30 PROVISIONAL), combination engine (independent format scores, combined only when both formats eligible, NULL plus status otherwise, ADJUSTED_ESTIMATE kept separate), sensitivity metrics (Top 10 overlap, Spearman, movement, eligibility changes, pairwise matrices), deterministic outputs, model_versions registration. Depends on FEAT-001 modules (proxy_samples, shrinkage, ranking, confidence_engine, reporting, integrity).
steps: Create config/format_weights_v1.json (version, created_date, status PROVISIONAL, rationale, default_config_id w70_30, eight configurations 100:0, 85:15, 80:20, 70:30, 60:40, 55:45, 50:50, 0:100).

Create app/analytics/format_config.py: load/validate (FormatConfigError), canonical sha256 hash, Settings consistency warning, register_config_in_model_versions(db_path, cfg) idempotent insert of model_versions row 'format-weights-v1' (PROVISIONAL, hash in config_json) using a read-write connection only when called.

Create app/analytics/normalization_engine.py: format-level eligibility (P25 level, repeated at P10 and P50 via confidence_engine), z-score within format eligible pool, combined score and statuses BOTH_FORMATS_VALID / SINGLE_FORMAT_IPL_ONLY / SINGLE_FORMAT_T20I_ONLY / NO_VALID_FORMAT, ADJUSTED_ESTIMATE column/section, per-config rankings (stable tie-break by player_id), metrics vs default and pairwise 8x8 matrices (overlap, Spearman with n), movement, entering/leaving Top 10, biggest movers, eligibility-change summary incl. degenerate 100:0 and 0:100 handling.

Create scripts/run_format_weight_sensitivity.py (args --db --reports-dir --config --register; snapshot before/after) writing format_weight_sensitivity.json (provenance: config id/version/weights/hash, data_version, code_version, generated_at_utc; every ranking row carries config id/version/weights/hash; separate batters and bowlers; format-specific and combined rankings) and format_weight_sensitivity_report.md whose first section states proxy_run / PENDING_PHASE3 / PROVISIONAL default. Run it with --register once on the real DB after tests pass.
Write tests/test_format_weights.py per plan test list, including byte-identical rerun apart from generated_at_utc and the model_versions registration on a temp DB.
acceptance_criteria: format_weight_sensitivity.json and format_weight_sensitivity_report.md exist under d:/Data/backend/data/reports/, JSON valid, contains all eight configs for batters and bowlers
Missing-format players have NULL combined score and an explicit status; no zero-filled value anywhere
Two consecutive runs are byte-identical except generated_at_utc
model_versions has exactly one new row 'format-weights-v1' (PROVISIONAL) after --register; official tables and CSVs unchanged
verification: python -m ruff check . ; python -m ruff format --check .
findings:
FEAT-002 done. tests/test_format_weights.py 21 passed; full pytest 95 passed before the last test-only fix (then re-ran file: 21 passed); ruff check and format clean. Script run with --register exit 0: model_versions gained exactly one row (id 7) format-weights-v1 WEIGHTING_CONFIG PROVISIONAL (hash in config_json); official tables and CSVs unchanged (preservation snapshot excludes db file hash after insert). Two consecutive plain runs: JSON and MD byte-identical apart from generated_at_utc. The final JSON on disk is from a plain run, so model_version_registration is null there (the --register run reported inserted True).
FILES: config/format_weights_v1.json (hash a77cb111d1efe20e2637fed21f528bb5ee2d4e627e0963338b73d64ef1ec7417; eligibility_levels primary P25, robustness P10,P50); app/analytics/format_config.py (load_config, validate_config, FormatConfigError, config_hash, settings_consistency, register_config_in_model_versions); app/analytics/normalization_engine.py (format_tables, build_player_frame, combined_scores, adjusted_estimate, evaluate_role, run_sensitivity, status constants); app/analytics/format_weight_report.py (render_report); scripts/run_format_weight_sensitivity.py (--db --reports-dir --config --register); tests/test_format_weights.py. Outputs: data/reports/format_weight_sensitivity.json and format_weight_sensitivity_report.md.
RESULTS (proxy, P25 balls rule): thresholds batter IPL 14 / T20I 15 balls, bowler 36/36 legal balls. Combined population: batters 133 (IPL-only 124, T20I-only 373, none 194), bowlers 114 (IPL-only 88, T20I-only 260, none 134). Top 10 overlap with default 70:30 batters 7,8,9,10,9,9,9,7... order w100_0 7, w85_15 8, w80_20 9, w60_40 9, w55_45 9, w50_50 9, w0_100 7; Spearman 0.931, 0.980, 0.990, 0.990, 0.980, 0.968, 0.754. Bowlers overlap 7,9,10,10,10,9,5; Spearman 0.938, 0.979, 0.990, 0.983, 0.968, 0.935, 0.493. 100:0 and 0:100 ranks equal single-format z ranks (checked). Eligibility identical across all 8 configs. Robustness combined population: batters P10 162, P25 133, P50 94; bowlers P10 134, P25 114, P50 72 (nested, no leavers when lowering).
NOTES FOR LATER STEPS: eligibility here is P25 on balls only (weight independent), not the Decision 2 recommendation. Players are not named except in per-role technical appendix (default Top 10). format_weight_report.py is the md renderer. The test for registration deletes the row from a temp DB copy first, so it is independent of the real DB state. ruff format was run over app/scripts/tests (all files already formatted afterwards). No git commits.
